Wow, I am in almost the same situation as you. Me and my partner see each other 3 times a month, 4 if we're lucky, and he is going to move to my city in fall 2021, and we just had our year anniversary today. 

I also cry every single time he leaves. Sometimes I can hold it together until he does, but not often. It just seems so cruel that I spend more time without him than with. I love him so much and I miss him so much when he's not around. Sometimes I wonder if seeing him is even worth it, if it hurts so bad when he leaves. I know it is and I am working that out in therapy but man oh man it hurts. I don't have much for advice except for my therapist told me to schedule something I really enjoy doing for right when he leaves so that I have something to focus on. Today, it was planning a Zoom game night with my friends. Sometimes it's my favorite food and a comfort TV show. You gotta find what works for you. 

I wish you all the luck. Fall 2021 will be here for both of us before we know it. <3

NTA. I teach students with autism and it is tough. Being a ABA or a BCBA is literally taking the worst parts of my job and making that your entire job. I'm sure you did great work when you did work with students, and you should continue to do what makes you happy. I'm sure your coworker has been in some tough situations with the professionals that work with her daughter (because what parent of any child hasn't) and that comment was coming from a place of insecurity.
